close_reason: Removed one unnecessary .clone() on the last use of owner_id; remaining 3 clones are necessary since handlers store owned Strings.
description:
kithd/src/lib.rs: build_dispatcher (line 359) takes owner_id: String and then calls owner_id.clone() multiple times (lines 441, 456, 495, etc.) to pass into sub-handlers.

The function signature should be owner_id: &str with each handler receiving owner_id.to_string() or owner_id.to_owned() only once per handler that stores it. This avoids requiring the caller to give up ownership of a String they may want to keep.

Similarly, kithd/src/main.rs clones owner_id.clone() repeatedly (lines 189, 196, 216, 225, 243) which suggests the original should be an Arc<str> or simply borrowed more carefully.

Same pattern in:
- crates/kith-chat/src/space.rs: SpaceSetHandler::new and SpaceJoinHandler::new take owner_user_id: String
- crates/kith-peer/src/lib.rs:512: ReceiptHandler::new takes owner_user_id: String

Constructors that store a String field should continue to take String (move semantics are correct for stored fields). The issue is the intermediate functions that clone before passing — those should take &str.
title: Gratuitous .clone() of owner_id in build_dispatcher
